# Work Item Plan
## Work Item WI-001: Backend levels service
### Identity
- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- title: Backend levels service
- kind: backend
### Goal
- summary: WHEN 服务启动并收到关卡相关请求 THE SYSTEM SHALL 使用 Node 内置模块提供可注入的关卡数据 API 与静态托管能力。
### Non Goals
- non_goals: 不实现前端页面逻辑、关卡玩法、认证、数据库、外部服务或 npm 依赖。
### Dependencies
- depends_on: []
### Inputs
### Outputs
- contract_id: CT-001
- capabilities: createServer(options) dataPath and staticRoot injection
- capabilities: start({ port }) lifecycle with origin port stop
- capabilities: GET /api/levels success response
- capabilities: GET /api/levels error response
- capabilities: static hosting path safety and content types
- capabilities: five-level data validation constraints
### Tasks
- task_id: TASK-001
- statement: WHEN 后端实现关卡数据文件 THE SYSTEM SHALL 在 data/levels.json 中提供恰好五项且满足字段约束的关卡。
- requirement_refs: REQ-003
- done_when_refs: AC-001
- task_id: TASK-002
- statement: WHEN 实现服务入口 THE SYSTEM SHALL 提供 createServer(options) 与 start({ port }) 的可注入生命周期接口。
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- done_when_refs: AC-002
- task_id: TASK-003
- statement: WHEN 实现关卡 API THE SYSTEM SHALL 按 CT-001 返回成功响应与 JSON 错误响应。
- requirement_refs: REQ-002
- done_when_refs: AC-003
- task_id: TASK-004
- statement: WHEN 实现静态托管 THE SYSTEM SHALL 安全解析静态路径并返回正确 Content-Type。
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- done_when_refs: AC-004
- task_id: TASK-005
- statement: WHEN 后端测试被执行 THE SYSTEM SHALL 通过 tests/backend 内至少一个测试文件完成 node --test 验证。
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-005
### Write Policy
- exclusive_scopes: server/**
- exclusive_scopes: data/levels.json
- exclusive_scopes: tests/backend/**
- forbidden_scopes: web/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/frontend/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/integration/**
### Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-001
- statement: WHEN 服务读取 data/levels.json THE SYSTEM SHALL 接受恰好五项且 id 非空唯一、name 非空、difficulty 属于 {简单, 普通, 困难}、unlocked 为布尔的记录。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-002
- statement: WHEN start 以 port 0 启动 THE SYSTEM SHALL resolve 为包含 http://127.0.0.1 实际 origin、实际 port 和 Promise 型 stop 的对象。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-003
- statement: WHEN 收到 GET /api/levels THE SYSTEM SHALL 在数据有效时返回五项 JSON 数组，并在数据无效或方法路径不受支持时返回符合 CT-001 的 JSON 错误。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-004
- statement: WHEN 使用后端自有 staticRoot 夹具托管静态资源 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回正确资源、缺失资源文本 404，并拒绝越出静态根目录的路径。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-005
- statement: WHEN 运行 node --test tests/backend THE SYSTEM SHALL 执行至少一个后端测试且全部通过。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
### Verification
- check_id: CHECK-001
- command: node --test tests/backend
- manual_instruction: null
- required: true
- non_zero_test_execution_required: true
### Handoff Schema
- required_fields: contract_id
- required_fields: capabilities
- provided_contract_refs: CT-001
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-001
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-002
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-003
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-004
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-005
### Blockers
### Traceability
- source_type: design
- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-002
- source_type: design
- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-003
- source_type: design
- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-004
- source_type: design
- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: NFR-001
## Work Item WI-002: Native level select page
### Identity
- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-002
- title: Native level select page
- kind: frontend
### Goal
- summary: WHEN 用户打开关卡选择页 THE SYSTEM SHALL 使用原生页面脚本渲染关卡列表并在请求失败时保留可读错误提示。
### Non Goals
- non_goals: 不修改后端实现、关卡数据、集成测试、关卡玩法或引入浏览器自动化与 npm 依赖。
### Dependencies
- depends_on: WI-001
### Inputs
- contract_id: CT-001
- provider_logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- required_capabilities: GET /api/levels success response
- required_capabilities: GET /api/levels error response
- required_capabilities: five-level data validation constraints
- compatibility_policy: require_all
### Outputs
- contract_id: CT-002
- capabilities: web/index.html page entry and container markers
- capabilities: web/level-select.js relative API path reference
- capabilities: initLevelSelect({ document, fetchImpl }) injection interface
- capabilities: success rendering behavior with name difficulty and locked state
- capabilities: API failure degradation behavior
### Tasks
- task_id: TASK-006
- statement: WHEN 构建页面入口 THE SYSTEM SHALL 在 web/index.html 提供 loading、level-list 和 error-message 容器并加载 web/level-select.js。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-006
- task_id: TASK-007
- statement: WHEN 实现页面脚本 THE SYSTEM SHALL 导出可注入 document 与 fetchImpl 的 initLevelSelect({ document, fetchImpl }) 接口。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-007
- task_id: TASK-008
- statement: WHEN fetchImpl 返回合法五项数组 THE SYSTEM SHALL 用文本安全方式渲染名称、难度和 unlocked 锁定态。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-008
- task_id: TASK-009
- statement: WHEN fetchImpl 失败或响应结构无效 THE SYSTEM SHALL 显示可读错误并保留页面容器不白屏。
- requirement_refs: REQ-006
- done_when_refs: AC-009
- task_id: TASK-010
- statement: WHEN 前端测试被执行 THE SYSTEM SHALL 通过 DOM 替身完成渲染与错误分支的 node --test 验证。
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-010
### Write Policy
- exclusive_scopes: web/**
- exclusive_scopes: tests/frontend/**
- forbidden_scopes: server/**
- forbidden_scopes: data/levels.json
- forbidden_scopes: tests/backend/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/integration/**
### Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-006
- statement: WHEN 读取 web/index.html THE SYSTEM SHALL 发现三个容器标记和对 web/level-select.js 的引用。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-007
- statement: WHEN 前端测试导入 web/level-select.js THE SYSTEM SHALL 能调用 initLevelSelect({ document, fetchImpl }) 并注入 DOM 与 fetch 替身。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-008
- statement: WHEN DOM 替身提供合法关卡数组 THE SYSTEM SHALL 渲染每项名称与难度并对 unlocked=false 显示锁定状态。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-009
- statement: WHEN DOM 替身模拟 API 失败或无效响应 THE SYSTEM SHALL 进入错误分支并保留可见页面框架。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-010
- statement: WHEN 运行 node --test tests/frontend THE SYSTEM SHALL 执行至少一个前端测试且全部通过。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
### Verification
- check_id: CHECK-002
- command: node --test tests/frontend
- manual_instruction: null
- required: true
- non_zero_test_execution_required: true
### Handoff Schema
- required_fields: contract_id
- required_fields: capabilities
- provided_contract_refs: CT-002
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-006
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-007
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-008
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-009
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-010
### Blockers
### Traceability

- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-005
- source_type: design
- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-006
- source_type: design
- source_id: design_spec_0001

## Work Item WI-003: Same-origin integration evidence
### Identity
- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-003
- title: Same-origin integration evidence
- kind: integration
### Goal
- summary: WHEN 后端服务与前端页面产物集成 THE SYSTEM SHALL 通过同一 HTTP 来源验证页面入口、脚本契约和 API 契约。
### Non Goals
- non_goals: 不修改 server/**、web/**、data/levels.json、上游测试或产品实现，不重复验证浏览器内动态渲染。
### Dependencies
- depends_on: WI-001
- depends_on: WI-002
### Inputs
- contract_id: CT-001
- provider_logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- required_capabilities: createServer(options) dataPath and staticRoot injection
- required_capabilities: start({ port }) lifecycle with origin port stop
- required_capabilities: GET /api/levels success response
- required_capabilities: GET /api/levels error response
- required_capabilities: static hosting path safety and content types
- required_capabilities: five-level data validation constraints
- compatibility_policy: require_all
- contract_id: CT-002
- provider_logical_work_item_id: WI-002
- required_capabilities: web/index.html page entry and container markers
- required_capabilities: web/level-select.js relative API path reference
- compatibility_policy: require_all
### Outputs
- contract_id: CT-003
- capabilities: integration HTTP evidence for same-origin page and API contract
- capabilities: input example start({ port: 0 })
- capabilities: output example { origin, port, stop }
- capabilities: input example GET <origin>/
- capabilities: output example HTML containing id=loading id=level-list id=error-message
- capabilities: input example GET <origin>/api/levels
- capabilities: output example top-level array length five
- capabilities: output example error body {"error":{"code":"LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE"}}
### Tasks
- task_id: TASK-011
- statement: WHEN 编写集成验证 THE SYSTEM SHALL 在 tests/integration 内使用 port 0 启动服务并保证 stop 清理。
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- done_when_refs: AC-011
- task_id: TASK-012
- statement: WHEN 集成请求页面入口 THE SYSTEM SHALL 断言同源 GET / 返回包含三个容器标记与 web/level-select.js 引用的 HTML。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-012
- task_id: TASK-013
- statement: WHEN 集成读取页面脚本响应 THE SYSTEM SHALL 断言 web/level-select.js 引用相对路径 /api/levels。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-013
- task_id: TASK-014
- statement: WHEN 集成请求关卡 API THE SYSTEM SHALL 断言成功响应为数组、包含五项且字段满足 EXE-006。
- requirement_refs: REQ-002
- done_when_refs: AC-014
- task_id: TASK-015
- statement: WHEN 集成使用 tests/integration 内无效数据夹具启动可注入服务 THE SYSTEM SHALL 断言 API 返回 JSON 500 和 LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE。
- requirement_refs: REQ-002
- done_when_refs: AC-015
- task_id: TASK-016
- statement: WHEN 集成测试被执行 THE SYSTEM SHALL 通过 tests/integration 内至少一个测试完成 node --test 验证。
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-016
- task_id: TASK-017
- statement: WHEN 记录联调验证步骤 THE SYSTEM SHALL 提供 CT-003 声明的请求输入示例和响应输出示例。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-017

- forbidden_scopes: server/**
- forbidden_scopes: web/**
- forbidden_scopes: data/levels.json
- forbidden_scopes: tests/backend/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/frontend/**
### Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-011
- statement: WHEN 集成服务启动 THE SYSTEM SHALL 在实际 origin 上完成请求并使用 stop() 释放监听。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
